paragraphs: Rav Adda. “Rav Adda recited.” (See Rav Acha bar Yosef.) He came to Rabbi Abbahu (see there). “Rav Ashi’s view is reasonable,” Menachot 59b. Before Rava, in Rabbi Avira’s name, Menachot 43, beginning of a. “They say in Rabbi Shila’s academy,” Chelek 108b. Rav Shmuel bar Pappa explained it before him. I do not know who this Rav Adda is. He said in Rav’s name, chapter Hattekhelet 39a.
